skills.name: Plum Blossom Strike (寒梅裁雪/寒梅裁雪)
skills.line: Do you like painting Winter Blossom Brach in Spring?
skills.description: SP Kachou Fuugetsu paints a colorful flower branch to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and she gains helter (lasts for 1 turn).

skills.name: Bound by Ink (墨气常萦/墨気常縈)
skills.line: A few strokes mark the passing of a few centuries.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Grants Inkbound to all allies. ; Inkbound (墨縈) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When HP is restored, amount restored is increased by 20%.

upgrades.text: '''Inkbound''': Boost to amount restored increases to 30%.
At the start of battle, max HP is permanently increased by 10% for all non-summoned allies with Inkbound.
When the Lifelike Image disappears outside of SP Kachou Fuugetsu's turn, her move bar is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Picturesque Life (绘梦浮生/絵夢浮生)
skills.line: All these blossoms are nothing more than a scroll of old memories.
skills.description:
SP Kachou Fuugetsu summons a Lifelike Image, sustained for 4 turns. It draws all enemies into a picturesque field then inflicts a selected non-summoned enemy with Ink-chased. If the marked enemy is KO'd, the Lifelike Image will disappear.
When the Lifelike Image is present, this skill changes to Blossom Rain. ; Ink-chased (逐墨) : :'''General, Mark''': Whenever other enemies receive non-transferred damage, the Lifelike Image deals 10% of that damage as transferred damage to the inflicted target. ; Lifelike Image (浮生画影) : A special summoned entity, cannot receive damage, is immune to debuffs and control effects and it is immobile. Damage dealt by the Lifelike Image cannot exceed 1200% of SP Kachou Fuugetsu's max HP. :''(Uses enemy summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: Lifelike Image's transferred damage to inflicted enemies increases to 15%.
When Lifelike Image is present, AOE damage dealt by allies is increased by 10%.
Lifelike Image's transferred damage to inflicted enemies increases to 25%.
When Lifelike Image is present, AOE damage dealt by allies is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Blossom Rain (繁花坠露/繁花墜露)
skills.description:
SP Kachou Fuugetsu restores the HP of an ally other than herself by 8% of her max HP. The same restore effect will then bounce to 2 allies, prioritizing allies with the lowest HP.
If the restore effect crits, the Lifelike Image will deal transferred damage equal to 20% of HP restored to the enemy marked with Ink-chased. If the inflicted enemy is a monster, the Lifelike Image will deal transferred damage equal to 100% the amount of HP restored instead.
When the Lifelike Image disappears, this skill changes to Picturesque Life.

upgrades.text: Number of times the restore effect triggers increases to 3.
Number of times the restore effect triggers increases to 4.

bio.condition: Team SP Kachou Fuugetsu with another player's Kachou Fuugetsu and clear any zone 10 times.
Increase SP Kachou Fuugetsu's skills 8 times.
Increase SP Kachou Fuugetsu's level to 40.
